title: Core note DECISION_WITHDRAWN: the owner's decision the session recorded was withdrawn — take it out of CLAUDE.md if it was added there, otherwise do nothing, write nobody
note: PR #543: hub decided undo <seq> withdraws a decision recorded by mistake; the session that was told gets DECISION_WITHDRAWN. The system prompt is the hub skill + the core's addendum, the same for both versions; the core's own words are the constant of each version (⟦KEY⟧, a version without it gets an empty line — the baseline). Run with --before <main before the change> --trials 8 and --only before|after in two processes. Checks: added — the session takes that one line out of its CLAUDE.md (an edit of the file, not a rewrite of it), does not write to the owner; not-added — nothing is touched (no edit, no message), a short reply. used-in-code: the core's text does not say what to do with what the decision already did (the docs: it stays) — a session that reverts its code or asks the owner does more than the text asks.
